about: Each case is a text and the flags a well-calibrated reader should and should not raise. A label is fair (the reader should raise it) or noise (the reader should not). Each reader flag is matched against the labels in order, and the first label whose pattern matches gets it, so put narrower labels before broader ones. Flags that match no label are counted as unlabeled, for a person to label later. Labels on the three rewrites come from the owner's review of first real use, on 6 October 2026.
